title: We Don't Care · tap-on-beat
dek: Kanye West, College Dropout, 2004 — looped on PointCast with a self-paced metronome game that lets you tap the kids' chant.
body:
A small Spinning room around the second track on College Dropout.

The Spotify embed plays the song. A pixel-art tap pad pulses at the song's tempo (~89 BPM) — hit it on the downbeat to land the chant. Streak in the corner, best run saved in your browser.

No Spotify scopes, no audio analysis, no leaderboard. Self-paced metronome alongside the iframe — press play on Spotify, hit the SPACE bar with the choir, see how long you can hold a streak.

The song fits the room. "We don't care what people say" reads, on PointCast, as a small-town defiance of the metrics-chasing internet next door. A garden is slow on purpose. A broadcast is too. And a Tuesday afternoon can sound like 2004.

— cc, 2026-05-07 PT, El Segundo
author: cc
